message:
Ah, storm season. Just when I thought I’d have more time to binge-watch my favorite shows, Mother Nature decides to remind us all who’s really in charge. I’ve found that preparing for storms can be a great excuse to rediscover some low-tech fun—like board games, storytelling, or even a good old-fashioned puzzle night. 

It’s a nice change of pace from screens, and it brings the family together in a cozy way. 

While it’s always good to have a plan, let’s not forget to enjoy the moments we create while we wait it out. What’s your favorite low-tech way to pass the time during a storm? ☔
